actions.name: Gain unauthorized access to victim networks through phishing emails with malicious zip file attachment
actions.description: OnePercent Group actors gain unauthorized access to victim networks through phishing emails with a malicious zip file attachment.

actions.name: Open Microsoft Word or Excel document with malicious macros from zip attachment
actions.description: The zip file includes a Microsoft Word or Excel document that contains malicious macros that allow the actors to subsequently infect the victim’s system with the banking Trojan IcedID.

actions.name: Infect victim system with IcedID banking Trojan
actions.description: The attachment’s macros infect the system with the IcedID banking trojan.

actions.name: Use IcedID to install and execute Cobalt Strike on victim network
actions.description: IcedID downloads additional software to include Cobalt Strike.

actions.name: Move laterally in network using Cobalt Strike and PowerShell remoting
actions.description: Cobalt Strike moves laterally in the network, primarily with PowerShell remoting.

actions.name: Use rclone for data exfiltration from victim network
actions.description: The actors use rclone for data exfiltration from the victim’s network.

actions.name: Deploy ransomware after approximately one month of presence in victim network
actions.description: The actors have been observed within the victim’s network for approximately one month prior to deployment of the ransomware.

actions.name: Send ransom note stating data encrypted and exfiltrated with instructions to contact via TOR
actions.description: OnePercent Group actors leave a ransom note stating the data has been encrypted and exfiltrated. The note states the victim needs to contact the OnePercent Group actors on TOR or the victim data will be leaked.

actions.name: Follow up with emails and phone calls threatening data leak if no prompt communication
actions.description: If the victim does not make prompt communication within a week of infection, the OnePercent Group actors follow up with emails and phone calls to the victim stating the data will be leaked.

actions.name: Threaten to release a portion of stolen data to clearnet websites if ransom not paid quickly
actions.description: If the victim does not pay the ransom quickly, the OnePercent Group actors threaten to release a portion of the stolen data to various clearnet websites.

actions.name: Threaten to sell stolen data to Sodinokibi Group for auction if ransom not paid in full
actions.description: If the ransom is not paid in full after the “one percent leak”, OnePercent Group actors threaten to sell the stolen data to the Sodinokibi Group to publish at an auction.

actions.name: Contact victims via phone calls with ransom demands using spoofed numbers
actions.description: Victims start to receive phone calls through spoofed phone numbers with ransom demands.

actions.name: Provide ProtonMail email address for further communication and negotiation
actions.description: Victims are provided a ProtonMail email address for further communication.

actions.name: Persistently demand to speak with victim company’s designated negotiator or threaten to publish stolen data
actions.description: Actors persistently demand to speak with a victim company’s designated negotiator or otherwise threaten to publish the stolen data.

actions.name: Send subsequent threats to publish stolen data via ProtonMail if victim does not respond
actions.description: When a victim company does not respond, the actors send subsequent threats to publish the victim company’s stolen data via the same ProtonMail email address.
